runs.name: Legence Corp.; Nasdaq LGN, SEC CIK 0002052568, an Up-C IPO of September 2025 with a Tax Receivable Agreement, Blackstone funds controlling about 61%; MEP engineering, installation and maintenance in Engineering & Consulting and Installation & Maintenance, the latter deciding; The Bowers Group bought 2026-01-02
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$43.53** a share (close 2026-10-16, `tools/run.py` live quote, aggregator, flagged). Shares **108,075,480**, Class A 76,904,346 plus Class B 31,171,134, an Up-C, each Class B share paired with an LGN B Unit exchangeable one for one, both counted (10-Q for the quarter to 2026-06-30, `0002052568-26-000026`, cover; checked against the balance sheet and Note 12; the follow-ons of 2025-12-15 and 2026-04-08 secondary sales and exchanges; no treasury shares; the Bowers $50M deferred consideration of 2026-12-31 payable in cash or Class A shares not in the count); cap **$4,704.5M**. Sovereign **5.43%** (US Treasury 30-year par yield, 2026-10-16). Documents read: 10-K 2025 (`0002052568-26-000008`), the 10-Qs of 2026-03-31 and 2026-06-30, DEF 14A of 2026-04-29 (`0001193125-26-188984`), the IPO 424B4 of 2025-09-15 (`0001193125-25-202469`) for 2022, the 8-K of 2026-01-02 (Bowers closing, $200M incremental term loan), the 8-K/A of 2026-03-19 (Bowers audited statements), the 8-Ks of 2026-03 to 2026-08. Cross-check: 2025 operating cash $256,873 thousand on the filed statement against 256.9 tagged. The brief's one stated departure: lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7 (eight, listed in the run file). Rivals from the 10-K's own list: Comfort Systems USA (10-K) and Stantec (40-F, CAD); Affiliated Engineers, WSP Global, ACCO Engineered Systems and Southland Industries flagged as not SEC filers; rival figures XBRL transcriptions, flagged. **Q1 IN**, narrowly **[M2012-065]**, **[M2011-014]**, **[M1998-044]**: an MEP engineer and fixed-price contractor, data centers and technology 42.7% of 2025 revenue (32.0% in 2023), **[L2009-005]** carried to Q2. **Q2 OUT** **[M2011-015]**, **[M2002-050]**, **[M2005-020]**, **[L2000-017]**, **[M1997-010]**, **[L2007-004]**, **[M2013-052]**: the deciding part Installation & Maintenance, 53.8% of three-year segment gross profit (a CONVENTION of the run: segment operating profit and a fifth year not filed); the money test answered yes on the filer's own history, "approximately 24 acquisitions since December 2020" to stand as "a leading provider"; no pricing power on the filer's own words, "we may not be able to offset such higher costs through price increases" on mostly fixed-price contracts; segment gross margin 14.1% / 15.1% / 16.3% (2023 to 2025) against Comfort Systems' company-wide 19.0% / 21.0% / 24.1%, Bowers 9.2% operating margin on its own audited statements; the field's last full cycle ordinary, Comfort Systems' EBITA margins 1.4% to 5.3% over 2009 to 2014, Stantec's net margins 1.1% to 5.9% in every year filed; the change-for-the-better reading (TOO HARD (NATURE)) considered and rejected in the run file. Q3 to Q12 not reached. Facts after the stop, recorded not judged: integrity facts (quarterly and annual guidance, a featured Adjusted EBITDA, material weaknesses in internal control unremediated at 2025 year-end); a net loss and a goodwill impairment in every year read, $21.6M goodwill and $19.5M long-lived impairments in the second quarter of 2026; tangible equity negative, the accumulated deficit $175.6M (2022) to $321.7M (2026-06-30); $565M borrowed in 2024 and $301.6M paid to the sponsor's parent, the IPO's $780M then repaying term debt; TRA liability $342.7M shown beside net debt $792.6M; contract liabilities $164M to $518M; the sponsor's about 61% block pledged under margin loans. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash (operating cash less all stock pay, capital spending and finance-lease principal) all-equity 27.5 / 51.1 / 65.8 / 219.6 ($M, 2022 to 2025), mean 91.0, equity-only mean 37.3; a serial acquirer ($535.7M of purchases), central on the organic pair, organic growth 13.5% derived from the MD&A's attribution percentages, Bowers added on its own record; value range $15.84 to $60.34 a share all-equity against $43.53, 2.47% no growth to 6.90% with growth at the price, best variant 7.57%, no case earning the floor; fair $15.05 all-equity, $14.42 equity-only; not armed (box OUT at Q2). Contamination declared by the analyst: the BCKIY commit subjects and a memory index line, and one `Test Runs/` listing filtered for LGN and Legence before the copy, returning nothing; none used. Commits 44fa139a (template), 8c79894b (Step 0, Q1), b14aefaf (Q2), 97e9adb9 (close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_cites.py` PASS (39 ids, 20 fragments); the dispatcher's `fold_cite_check.py`, 15 quoted fragments beside an id, all in their rows: **no slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) Q2's ordinary-returns OUT and its change-for-the-better TOO HARD (NATURE) overlap and the text does not say which governs; (2) the parts rule names five-year operating profit, this filer reports three years of segment gross profit; (3) no rule for a short history, four and a half years against Q4's eight to ten and Q7's five; (4) the Up-C and TRA: the TRA in net debt, the company's own tax when 85% of the savings go to former owners, stock pay settled by the sponsor's vehicles; (5) the serial-acquirer rule's organic growth "as the filer reports it" when the filer reports none. Could not get: eight to ten balance sheets, a five-year window, segment operating profit, the design-build and plan-and-spec split, the proxy's bonus metric, the sponsor's current stake.
runs.narr: OUT at Q2 (Legence Corp., Nasdaq LGN, an Up-C IPO of September 2025 controlled by Blackstone funds; MEP engineering, installation and maintenance in Engineering & Consulting and Installation & Maintenance, data centers and technology 42.7% of 2025 revenue; Bowers bought 2026-01-02). Q1 IN narrowly; Q2 OUT on Installation & Maintenance (53.8% of three-year segment gross profit): the position assembled with money in about 24 acquisitions since December 2020, no pricing power on the filer's own words, gross margin below Comfort Systems' in every year compared, the field's last full cycle ordinary. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: guidance, a featured Adjusted EBITDA, material weaknesses. Computation beneath the stop $15.84 to $60.34 all-equity against $43.53, no case earning the floor, fair $15.05 all-equity ($14.42 equity-only), not armed. Framework gaps for the operator: Q2's two closes overlapping, segment gross profit for parts, a short filing history, the Up-C and TRA, organic growth never filed.
